ns2:course.label: Classics in Business Administration
ns2:course.description: Graduate seminar. Presents foundational literature to introduce the theoretical origins of the different areas of Business Administration and explores the linkages among these areas. Outlines the impact of the foundational works on subsequent research. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Ph.D. standing in BADM or consent of instructor.
